name: About the top100 selection
value: TPB indexer uses top100_recent for its TEST and keyword-less searches. However TPB will often only include Movies and TV in its top100_recent list which makes setting up Lidarr for Audio or other similar *Arr apps problematic. By changing the top100 selector you will make the indexer use a more focused top100 for the category group your *Arr app uses.

name: About filtering by Uploader
value:
You can filter by Uploader by entering a Case Sensitive username, or leave empty to get all results.
Note: this is the username of the Uploader and not the Groupname that often show up at the end of TPB titles, eg -MeGusta.
